# go build -buildmode=pie -race main.go on Darwin should work without errors

[!race] skip 'test requires race detector support'

[!GKOS:darwin] ! go build -buildmode=pie -race
[!GKOS:darwin] stderr '^-buildmode=pie not supported when -race is enabled on '$GKOS'/'$GKARCH'$'
[!GKOS:darwin] stop 'not testing -buildmode=pie -race on platform that does not support it'

go build -buildmode=pie -race bytes
! stderr .

[short] stop 'not linking a binary in -short mode'

go build -buildmode=pie -race main.go
! stderr .
exec ./main
stdout 'Hello, 世界'

-- go.mod --
module m

go 1.21
-- main.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("Hello, 世界")
}
